run_pre_release: run the pre_release_work function to bump the version before a release
run_post_release: run the post_release_work function to bump the version to the next dev release
update_version_global: update the version string across all init setup and example files at once
get_current_version: read and return the current version string from the diffusers init file
clean_readme_model_links: replace main branch doc links with stable doc links in the README model list
